summary: Shows creating and removing user accounts ad hoc with the user module, and points to the module docs for group handling.
questions: How do I create a user on all hosts with one ansible command?
How do I remove a user account from every managed node?
Does the user module take a plain-text or encrypted password?

answer_card.title: Manage users with ad hoc commands
answer_card.answer_md:
- Create: `ansible all -m ansible.builtin.user -a "name=foo password=<encrypted password here>"` (the password must be encrypted)
- Remove: `ansible all -m ansible.builtin.user -a "name=foo state=absent"`

See the `ansible.builtin.user` docs for groups and membership options.
